features: Lightweight All-Day Comfort: Experience a lightweight in-ear design that sits naturally without pressure. Built for long listening hours, perfect for everyday use, calls, and music on the go
10 mm Driver: Enjoy clear, balanced audio with a 10 mm dynamic driver tuned for everyday listening. Designed to enhance your music, podcasts, and calls with detail that doesn't fatigue your ears
Built-in Mic for Clear Calls: Stay heard wherever you are with a built-in in-line microphone. Answer, reject, and manage calls with a single button, so your voice always comes through clearly
Voice Assistant: A long press on the multi-function button instantly activates your phone's voice assistant, hands-free convenience built in
Type-C Connectivity: Plug straight into any Type-C smartphone, laptop, or tablet for instant digital sound. No pairing, no charging. Enjoy seamless plug-and-play across your everyday devices
